profiles.name: Victor Gynamani
profiles.head: VP, GCC Advisory, EY (ex-Regional Enterprise Client Partner - Captives/GCCs, Tech Mahindra)
strengths: At Tech Mahindra he was client partner for billion-dollar captive GCCs in India and APAC (technology, manufacturing, life sciences, CPG)
A recommendation describes him moving from inside sales to a true hunter at Bristlecone, bringing new business from SAP accounts
Runs EY GCC events in Pune with 200+ GCC leaders, so he has a deep GCC buyer network
gaps: His current EY role is advisory and consulting rather than a sales quota
His IT services sales skew to SAP and supply chain, with no testing (QE) background
profiles.next: Good GCC hunter profile within the 8-15 year band. Pitch a return to quota-carrying GCC sales with QE + AI services.

profiles.name: Mayuresh Kulkarni
profiles.head: Director - Digital Manufacturing, Capgemini (ex-Key Account Manager, LTTS)
strengths: Was a key account manager at LTTS selling engineering services to global FMCG and chemical accounts
Has run the full quote-to-cash sales cycle
gaps: His recent roles are solution architect and presales for Industry 4.0
Focused on manufacturing and engineering, with no testing (QE) work
profiles.next: Low priority; only if his current role has a sales quota

profiles.name: Mahesh Patil
profiles.head: India GCC BU Head & Pune Center Head, EPAM
strengths: Runs EPAM's India GCC business unit and has set up GCCs through BOT and cost-plus models
gaps: Far too senior for the role
profiles.next: Ask for referrals to GCC sellers in his team
